Trade journal and analytics for systematic trading — JORU

JORU is a trading journal for traders who want to understand what drives their results. Record and review trades, track equity and drawdowns, compare trading scenarios, and define strategy rules in one application for Windows and macOS.

See what is behind every trade’s result

From trade history to equity analysis and strategy rules. See how the application works.

A trading journal built around the decisions behind each trade

A useful trade journal keeps more than profit and loss. It records why you entered, how you managed risk, and whether you followed your rules. JORU brings trade records, performance review, and strategy work into one desktop application.

  1. Record the trade context

    Keep entry and exit conditions, notes, tags, and screenshots with each trade so you can revisit the decision after the session.

  2. Review performance

    Compare trades by scenario and strategy, inspect the equity curve and drawdowns, and identify recurring mistakes and strong decisions.

  3. Refine your rules

    Turn findings from your journal into clearer strategy conditions. Compare strategy versions to see how changes affect your results.

Start with the free trading journal. Advanced analytics and strategy tools are available in the Full plan. Learn more about plans.

Turn your trading history into a basis for decisions

  • Review your mistakes. Revisit trades, their conditions and your notes. Compare decisions with outcomes and look for recurring situations.
  • Evaluate your results. Follow changes in equity and drawdowns. Consider each trade in the context of your entire trading history.
  • Define your rules. Connect conditions, scenarios and actions in a visual diagram. Keep the logic of your trading system in view.

Compete and exchange experience

  • Take part in trading events. Test your forecasts and strategies in competitions. Earn points and win license keys and statuses.
  • Discuss the market with traders. Publish trading ideas, share observations and review strategies with other participants.

Google Sign-In and your data

JORU uses Google Sign-In only to create and identify your account. When you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email address and profile picture. We use this data to sign you in and to run your account: your profile, license, forum and events. Your trade journal and exchange API keys stay on your device. Your data is never sold or shared with advertisers. Privacy Policy.

Trading journal FAQ

What is JORU?
It is an application for keeping a trading journal, reviewing performance, and developing strategy rules. Use your trade history to make decisions based on your own data.
Who is this trading journal for?
It is for traders who want to review trades systematically, compare scenarios, and track performance metrics, from developing traders to experienced market participants.
What trading analysis tools does it include?
Review trade history and notes, analyze equity and drawdowns, and map the conditions and rules of your trading system.
Which computers support the application?
The application is available for Windows and macOS computers. See the pricing page for plan details and available features.
